other_failure_modes.name: Data leakage via frequency encoding before splitting
other_failure_modes.description: Calculating frequency encoding on the combined train and test dataset leaks the distribution of categories in the test set into the features used for training the model.

summary: The agent demonstrates good modeling practices overall, including robust ensembling, extensive feature engineering, and proper cross-validation. However, it critically fails by computing statistics (median imputation and frequency encoding) on the combined train and test dataset before splitting, leading to data leakage. Additionally, it ignores the temporal nature of contract awards by using a randomized K-fold split instead of a time-based split.
